intro: Armenian officials face a major corruption investigation while the government advances EU integration talks and regional connectivity projects. Meanwhile, the Armenian diaspora marks institutional milestones and cultural initiatives.

topics.title: Armenian officials arrested in large bribery case
topics.text: The Anti-Corruption Committee confirmed the arrest of several officials, including from the Compulsory Enforcement Service and State Revenue Committee, in connection with a large bribe case. The investigation is ongoing.

sources.title: Several Armenia officials arrested in connection with large bribe case, Anti-Corruption Committee confirms
Armenia Compulsory Enforcement Service, State Revenue Committee officials arrested today

topics.title: Armenia advances EU membership bid and strategic partnership
topics.text: Prime Minister Pashinyan stated Armenia's road to EU membership could take 20 years, while EU officials confirmed member states will decide on the application. Foreign Minister Mirzoyan discussed visa liberalization and defense cooperation with European counterparts.

topics.title: Regional connectivity and 'Bridge of Peace' initiative progress
topics.text: Armenia and Azerbaijan are set to hold the next 'Bridge of Peace' civil society meeting in Armenia soon. Mirzoyan emphasized that reopening regional links could bring economic benefits to all countries in the South Caucasus.

sources.title: Reopening regional links could bring economic benefits to all countries, Mirzoyan says

topics.title: Armenia strengthens economic ties with Germany and Hungary
topics.text: Intergovernmental consultations with Germany focused on deepening economic cooperation, while the Armenian-Hungarian Business Council began work to facilitate trade. The first regular cargo flight on the Istanbul-Yerevan route was also operated.

topics.title: Diaspora organizations expand institutional presence and support
topics.text: The Hrayr Maroukhian Foundation gained membership in the Foundation for European Progressive Studies. Camp Haiastan received a historic $1.5 million gift, and the Pan-Armenian Youth Futbol Association continues developing talent pipelines to Armenia.

topics.title: Housing support extended for Karabakh displaced families
topics.text: The validity of housing support certificates for families displaced from Nagorno-Karabakh to Armenia has been extended for an additional six months. The measure aims to provide continued stability for displaced persons.

sources.title: Validity of certificates of housing support program for families displaced from Karabakh to Armenia extended for another 6 months

topics.title: La Francophonie Summit backs Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process
topics.text: The La Francophonie Summit adopted a resolution supporting the peace process between Armenia and Azerbaijan. The declaration adds international diplomatic weight to ongoing normalization efforts.

sources.title: La Francophonie Summit adopts resolution supporting Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process
